subject.title: feat(workspace): lint and auto-fix code fences in markdown at write time

question: Should OpenClaw add workspace Markdown code-fence linting at write time, and should the initial contract be auto-fix by default, warn-only, or explicit opt-in?
rationale: The feature mutates persisted workspace content and adds config/API surface; prior attempts showed parser edge cases that automation cannot safely resolve as a default product policy.

options.title: Warn Or Opt In First
options.body: Add parser-backed diagnostics or an explicit opt-in fix mode while keeping existing writes unchanged by default.

options.title: Default Auto-Fix
options.body: Rewrite workspace Markdown automatically on writes, accepting compatibility and parser-corruption risk for stronger formatting guarantees.

options.title: No Core Mutation
options.body: Leave workspace writes raw and rely on docs, prompts, external linters, or narrower runtime fixes for specific failures.

recommendation.title: Warn Or Opt In First
recommendation.body: Add parser-backed diagnostics or an explicit opt-in fix mode while keeping existing writes unchanged by default.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision hinges on Markdown parser safety and core write-time policy, where Peter has adjacent fence-handling history.
